The source package declares Android-Apache-2.0 in data/sounds/Android.bp.

Changes: decoded Vorbis audio and resampled to mono, 22050 Hz, 16-bit PCM WAV
with FFmpeg for browser compatibility. The waveform is bundled as base64
in shutter-sound.js for playback without network requests for audio.
